Dracula's Taste for Love beetroot dip

Roast beetroot blitzed blood red with feta, garlic, walnuts and lemon, served with oven-baked pita crisps dusted in smoked paprika. Wrap 3 medium beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for 50 minutes until tender, then peel. Blitz with 100g feta, 1 garlic clove, 40g walnuts, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil until smooth and season. Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, brush with oil, sprinkle with smoked paprika and salt and bake at 180C for 10 minutes until crisp. Serve the dip with crumbled feta on top.
M: Resort fish tacos with mango salsa
lunch by the pool at the resort

White fish dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, tucked into warm corn tortillas with mango salsa, lime and coriander. Cut 600g firm white fish fillets into strips and toss with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, salt and oil. Dice 1 mango, half a red onion and 1 red chilli and mix with coriander and the juice of 1 lime. Pan-fry the fish over high heat for 2 minutes a side until just cooked. Mix 120g sour cream with lime zest. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with shredded cabbage, fish, salsa and lime crema.

s.how: Cut 300g sashimi tuna into small cubes. Toss with 2 tbsp soy sauce, a teaspoon of sesame oil and sliced spring onion. Spoon onto rice crackers just before serving so they stay crisp. Eat by the pool at a Hawaiian resort.

s.note: Peter's surf lesson with the laid-back instructor Kunu
s.how: Cut a pineapple into long spears. Brush with honey mixed with lime juice. Grill over high heat, turning, until caramelised and charred at the edges. Serve warm with extra lime. Do less, and the pineapple does more.

m.note: the Hawaiian luau at the resort
m.how: Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with smoked salt. Wrap tightly in banana leaves, then foil, and cook at 150C for 5 hours until it falls apart. Shred and serve over jasmine rice with a crunchy shredded cabbage salad on the side.

w.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with the syrup and the juice of 2 limes until smooth. Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour for 4 hours. Scoop into glasses.

d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml dark rum with 60ml orange juice, 20ml lime juice and 15ml sugar syrup over ice. Strain over crushed ice and top with a sprig of mint. Make an orange and lime version without rum for anyone not drinking.
